DitherDissolveText.text: The text. It stays on one line.
DitherDissolveText.word: Dissolve each word instead of each character.
DitherDissolveText.showing: false dissolves the text out, true brings it back. Changing it plays the dissolve again.
DitherDissolveText.ink: The text colour and the flat colour behind it.
DitherDissolveText.backdrop: The text colour and the flat colour behind it.
DitherDissolveText.fill: What the letters settle into: solid, gradient, dotted or hatched.
DitherDissolveText.level: Gradient only: the coverage the letters settle at.
DitherDissolveText.stagger: The time between one unit and the next.
DitherDissolveText.delay: The time before the first unit starts.
DitherDissolveText.speed: Multiplies every timing. 2 plays twice as fast.
DitherDissolveText.animated: false shows the finished text at once.
